items.title: Israel targets top Hamas leader in deadly Gaza strike, killing five
items.description: On Saturday, the Israeli military attempted to kill Ali al-Amoudi in a pre-dawn strike on an apartment building. The airstrike killed five people, four of them women; Israel is reviewing whether al-Amoudi was among the dead.

items.title: Pakistan vs. Afghanistan: From allies and neighbors to war
items.description: For years, Pakistan supported the Taliban in Afghanistan. But now Pakistan is bombing its neighbor. How the former allies became adversaries and why negotiations keep failing.

items.title: Houthis claim strike on oil facilty near Riyadh, accuse Saudi forces of pounding Yemen's capital
items.description: Houthi rebels accused Saudi forces of launching 26 strikes on Sanaa on Saturday after loud explosions rocked the Yemeni capital. The Iran-backed group said it struck an oil facility south of Riyadh, where flames and a large plume of smoke were seen rising from a plant belonging to oil giant Aramco.

items.title: Cloaked in anonymity, Israeli soldiers describe mass civilian killings in 'NAZA'
items.description: NAZA is an acronym for nezek agavi, Hebrew for "collateral damage." It refers to the number of civilian casualties the Israeli military deems acceptable. The documentary is made by Israeli filmmakers.

items.title: ‘I have not lost my dreams’: Refugee education funding cuts threaten millions
